_comment: Proactive run notifications. Copy to notifications.json and set enabled: true. The notifier NEVER raises — a misconfigured webhook/email only logs a warning and never breaks a scrape run.
_webhook_guide: Any generic webhook that accepts a JSON POST. The payload includes a plain-text 'text' field (works with Slack, Discord, Mattermost, ntfy, etc.) plus the full run summary. Create a channel integration, paste its URL here, set enabled: true.
_email_guide: Optional SMTP email. starttls true for port 587 (Gmail uses an App Password, not your login password). 'to' is a list of recipient addresses.
